patch_description: Keep the prior architecture (one-time serialization + integer factorization, three bounded candidate constructions scored by the exact sorted-LCP Trie objective) and add the recommended bounded adjacent-swap hill-climb refinement: starting from the best flat global column order, repeatedly try swapping each adjacent column pair, accept a swap only when the exact Trie reuse score improves, capped at ~20 sweeps and a ~2.5s wall-clock budget. The refined order is scored against all candidates (including the conditional tree) and only kept if it truly wins under the real serial-Trie character objective. All scoring uses C-speed slice comparisons and shared serialized strings; per-row orders from the tree still compete, so the plateaued dataset gets a fresh search direction while the others are unchanged if no improvement is found.
